restart_prefix_audit.note: Matching initial weights,seed andorder,with numerical loss/gradient differences;their cause is not isolated. A final weights unavailable,no bitwise model-equivalence claim. Known A work is a lower bound.

diagnosis.verdict_zh: The first 3B training and diagnostic round is complete, but it has not produced a reliable broad R0 that replaces the old 0.8B checkpoint. Preserve it as an experimental candidate without promotion or formal DAPO efficiency comparisons.
diagnosis.verdict_en: The first 3B training and diagnostic round is complete, but it has not produced a reliable broad R0 that replaces the old 0.8B checkpoint. Preserve it as an experimental candidate without promotion or formal DAPO efficiency comparisons.

evidence.zh: On the same 128 matched-FP32 cases, 3B improves from20.957 to34.457 chrF++ and reaches14.510 BLEU, versus old R0 at34.567/15.701 and old SFT200 at36.037/16.031. The chrF++ difference versus SFT200 is−1.580,95% paired CI[−3.505,+0.674]: neither significant inferiority nor reliable superiority is established.
evidence.en: On the same 128 matched-FP32 cases, 3B improves from20.957 to34.457 chrF++ and reaches14.510 BLEU, versus old R0 at34.567/15.701 and old SFT200 at36.037/16.031. The chrF++ difference versus SFT200 is−1.580,95% paired CI[−3.505,+0.674]: neither significant inferiority nor reliable superiority is established.

evidence.zh: Technical 64 chrF++ is34.770, a−1.091 difference versus SFT200 with CI[−3.193,+1.645]. Medium/long48 scores35.170 versus36.518. Selection-development long-sentence gains do not establish reliable superiority on the separate reused diagnostic set.
evidence.en: Technical 64 chrF++ is34.770, a−1.091 difference versus SFT200 with CI[−3.193,+1.645]. Medium/long48 scores35.170 versus36.518. Selection-development long-sentence gains do not establish reliable superiority on the separate reused diagnostic set.

evidence.zh: After locking all 288 new semantic judgements, technical G8 coverage is2/24 versus3/24 for SFT200; long coverage remains0/10. All 32 coverage is5/32 versus7/32. Both have3 G outputs on the fixed greedy32, but new 3B has8 B outputs versus3. Semantics do not support promotion.

evidence.zh: Observed errors include platelets becoming blood groups, novel becoming new book, unreliable galaxy/binary-star/dust-lane terms, and changed clinical populations or legal deadlines. These semantic defects are not merely formatting issues solved by score normalization.
evidence.en: Observed errors include platelets becoming blood groups, novel becoming new book, unreliable galaxy/binary-star/dust-lane terms, and changed clinical populations or legal deadlines. These semantic defects are not merely formatting issues solved by score normalization.

evidence.zh: Reference MetricX selects G in both covered technical groups for new 3B; full reward has192 concordant,36 discordant and9 tied cross-tier pairs. It also selects G in all 3 covered old-SFT groups. Scarce observed correct candidates are a direct current limitation, but no DAPO is trained here and causal contributions to the old 30-step result remain unisolated. Historical failed reward controls still fail.
evidence.en: Reference MetricX selects G in both covered technical groups for new 3B; full reward has192 concordant,36 discordant and9 tied cross-tier pairs. It also selects G in all 3 covered old-SFT groups. Scarce observed correct candidates are a direct current limitation, but no DAPO is trained here and causal contributions to the old 30-step result remain unisolated. Historical failed reward controls still fail.

evidence.zh: The cheap read-only comparison does not support simply replacing MetricX with chrF. On new 3B technical groups, raw/full chrF gives60/56 discordant pairs and selects G in only1/2 covered groups; old-SFT chrF gives90 discordant pairs and2/3 selections. Lower cost does not establish more reliable semantic ranking.
evidence.en: The cheap read-only comparison does not support simply replacing MetricX with chrF. On new 3B technical groups, raw/full chrF gives60/56 discordant pairs and selects G in only1/2 covered groups; old-SFT chrF gives90 discordant pairs and2/3 selections. Lower cost does not establish more reliable semantic ranking.

evidence.zh: Training learns without an observed numerical failure:926 updates,999931 targets, dev NLL3.486→1.586 and weighted chrF++20.067→36.476, with the final checkpoint best and zero structural failures. The observed curve has not plateaued; this neither establishes a 3B capacity ceiling nor guarantees success from more training.
evidence.en: Training learns without an observed numerical failure:926 updates,999931 targets, dev NLL3.486→1.586 and weighted chrF++20.067→36.476, with the final checkpoint best and zero structural failures. The observed curve has not plateaued; this neither establishes a 3B capacity ceiling nor guarantees success from more training.

evidence.zh: The supported project judgement is that size alone has not solved starting-point/task fit. The raw3B is weak and bounded SFT improves it substantially without adequate candidate coverage. Model generation, pretraining, tokenizer and cumulative SFT history all differ, so training exposure versus language foundation/data coverage cannot be separately attributed.
evidence.en: The supported project judgement is that size alone has not solved starting-point/task fit. The raw3B is weak and bounded SFT improves it substantially without adequate candidate coverage. Model generation, pretraining, tokenizer and cumulative SFT history all differ, so training exposure versus language foundation/data coverage cannot be separately attributed.

next_steps.zh: Current decision: preserve new 3B and all 0.8B checkpoints. Old SFT200 remains the more practical comparator here, but is also not validated as a broad formal-DAPO base. This budget ends with the released GPU.
next_steps.en: Current decision: preserve new 3B and all 0.8B checkpoints. Old SFT200 remains the more practical comparator here, but is also not validated as a broad formal-DAPO base. This budget ends with the released GPU.

next_steps.zh: Prioritize starting-point screening without training: use the fixed 32 greedy sources and 8 preselected stratified G8 sources,2 general / 2 medium / 4 long. Inspect concepts and roles against cached comparators before committing to another million-token SFT. A single candidate is estimated at30–60 Colab minutes depending on downloads/runtime/generation; not executed.

next_steps.zh: If encoder–decoder is within scope, prioritize screening the [Google Research MADLAD3B MT release](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/master/madlad_400/README.md); its [converted model card](https://huggingface.co/google/madlad400-3b-mt) describes a T5 translation model. This is a task-based candidate, not measured English–Icelandic superiority. Conditional decoder logp, target masks and sampling require adaptation and validation; it is not a directory-only replacement.
next_steps.en: If encoder–decoder is within scope, prioritize screening the [Google Research MADLAD3B MT release](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/master/madlad_400/README.md); its [converted model card](https://huggingface.co/google/madlad400-3b-mt) describes a T5 translation model. next_steps.zh: After screening, freeze a clearly stronger starting point and a new quality holdout unused for selection, then do only the necessary SFT. If decoder-only is mandatory, first screen an allowed-size decoder-only model for actual English–Icelandic ability. Do not commit on the3B label alone.
next_steps.en: After screening, freeze a clearly stronger starting point and a new quality holdout unused for selection, then do only the necessary SFT. If decoder-only is mandatory, first screen an allowed-size decoder-only model for actual English–Icelandic ability. Do not commit on the3B label alone.

next_steps.zh: Once an actor supplies meaningful correct candidates, validate reward on semantic controls separate from model selection, then run bounded standard DAPO. Freeze actor/data/reward/sampling for selective-token and prefix-reuse efficiency research only after independent quality benefits or retention are credible.

limitations.zh: G/P/B/U labels are same-assistant AI-assisted judgements, not native certification; P/B boundaries are subjective. All outputs, randomized display order, reasons and lock hashes remain available for review.
limitations.en: G/P/B/U labels are same-assistant AI-assisted judgements, not native certification; P/B boundaries are subjective. All outputs, randomized display order, reasons and lock hashes remain available for review.

limitations.zh: The128 and G8 sources are reused development/diagnostic material, not untouched tests; reused old labels are not independent blind review. Single-seed source CIs omit document clustering and model-selection uncertainty.
limitations.en: The128 and G8 sources are reused development/diagnostic material, not untouched tests; reused old labels are not independent blind review. Single-seed source CIs omit document clustering and model-selection uncertainty.

limitations.zh: No G observed in G8 does not imply zero probability under unlimited sampling. P/B contrasts may still provide relative RL signals; this failed screen does not prove DAPO cannot learn.
limitations.en: No G observed in G8 does not imply zero probability under unlimited sampling. P/B contrasts may still provide relative RL signals; this failed screen does not prove DAPO cannot learn.

limitations.zh: Different tokenizers make the 256-token penalty a different character-length constraint; full-reward cross-model differences are not purely scorer differences. Reference/QE/chrF comparisons do not select a new reward mode, and historical failed controls remain recorded.
limitations.en: Different tokenizers make the 256-token penalty a different character-length constraint; full-reward cross-model differences are not purely scorer differences. Reference/QE/chrF comparisons do not select a new reward mode, and historical failed controls remain recorded.

limitations.zh: After A lost its assignment, B restarted from verified initial weights; these are not independent seeds. Total time/CU includes A work, B, evaluation and transfer; all old weights remain in place.
limitations.en: After A lost its assignment, B restarted from verified initial weights; these are not independent seeds. Total time/CU includes A work, B, evaluation and transfer; all old weights remain in place.

cost.note: Total observed balance change includes both attempts,all setup/downloads/evaluation/transfers. A assignment disappeared;exact removal time unknown and duration bounded. B restarted step0 with reused verified baseline,same seed/order;not an independent seed. Original absolute deadline retained. Settlement may lag.
